ABOUTME.TITLE: About Me
ABOUTME.INTRO1: I'm a full-stack developer focused on mobile development for Android, iOS, and cross-platform applications.
ABOUTME.INTRO2: I'm a computer engineer specializing in software architecture, and I'm also a full-stack developer specializing in mobile development for Android, iOS, and cross-platform applications. I also develop mobile and web applications using technologies like Ionic, and I develop both backend and frontend applications. I strive to create the most accessible applications possible, as this is very important to me, in addition to applying the correct architectures and design patterns. I enjoy using new, trending technologies like SwiftUI, but I also program in technologies that are becoming more outdated. I believe it's important to understand both, as they will coexist for the time being. I also perform application testing, manage databases, and develop microservices. If you'd like to learn more about my skills and projects, you can check out my profile.
